text:
### Observed differences

In the later window, the outgoing transitions from activity A02 are redistributed. The share of transitions going to A44 drops from about 29 in 100 to about 5 in 100, while the share going to A46 rises from about 17 in 100 to about 30 in 100. A15 also increases from about 12% to about 19%, and A16 from about 7% to about 12%. Several previously observed successors (A04, A18, A25, A27, A32, A38) disappear, and new ones appear (A05, A14, A26, A30, A35, A41, A45). These changes are based on 42 traces before and 43 after that contain A02. [DIR001]

### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Only one indicator passed the screening threshold, while about 0.43 items would be expected by chance alone; a single item is within the range of what an unchanged process typically produces, despite its high empirical strength. [DIR001, screening]

In the before window, A44 was the most common successor (about 29% of transitions), A46 about 17%, A15 about 12%, A20 and A19 about 10% each. In the after window, A46 becomes the most common (about 30%), A15 about 19%, A16 about 12%, A44 drops to about 5%, A20 about 7%, A19 about 2%. So the main difference: A44's share drops sharply, A46's share increases, and some new successors appear (A14, A41, A45, etc.) while some disappear (A04, A18, A25, etc.). But support: before 42, after 43 traces containing A02. So moderate support.
